title.zh: 双大马士革到底「双」在哪？
title.en: What is dual about dual damascene?

subtitle.zh: 一次铜填充，同时形成 Via 与 Metal Line
subtitle.en: One copper fill forms both via and metal line

body.zh: 双指 Via + Trench，不是填两次铜
body.en: Dual means via + trench, not two copper fills

body.zh: 连接下层金属与本层走线
body.en: Connect lower metal to current-layer routing

body.zh: Via-first 与 Trench-first 各有窗口
body.en: Via-first and trench-first have distinct windows

body.zh: 在 Low-k 中雕出两级空腔
body.en: Form a two-level cavity in Low-k

body.zh: 刻蚀、去胶、清洗都可能伤介质
body.en: Etch, strip and clean can damage the dielectric
Barrier, seed and ECP are all required

body.zh: 去掉多余铜，同时保护线形
body.en: Remove excess copper while protecting line geometry

body.zh: 从截面缺陷追到电性可靠性
body.en: Connect cross-section defects to electrical reliability

body.zh: 最难的不是填铜，而是把双层空腔做对
body.en: The hardest part is forming the correct two-level cavity, not filling copper
